name: Sort By
description: Sort a list of records by a field, ascending unless direction is 'desc' — numbers as numbers, text alphabetically, empty values last; for a table before it is shown, a report, a pick list.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= [...(items || [])].sort((a, b) => { const x = a == null ? undefined : a[field], y = b == null ? undefined : b[field]; const c = x == null ? 1 : y == null ? -1 : (typeof x === 'number' && typeof y === 'number' ? x - y : String(x).localeCompare(String(y), undefined, { numeric: true })); return String(direction || '').toLowerCase() === 'desc' ? -c : c; }) }}"}]
